notes: Mobile Harness Code — v1.9.0: built-in Template Library. Browse, search and pick ready-made web apps (dashboards, e-commerce, portfolio, landing pages and more) and turn one into an installable, signed Android APK with one tap. Four MIT templates are bundled for fully offline use; build-required and server-required projects are clearly labelled and never presented as ready. The library reuses the existing Web App (WebViewAssetLoader) pipeline and build/signing system — Compose, XML, SDK, PRoot, Gradle and release flows are unchanged. This APK is SIGNED (V3-only, production key); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
